text:
Sophie: Hey team — finalizing logistics for the Lilypad meetup tonight. Quick check: swag pickup, speaker slides, table banner, lead-capture QR routing. Need confirmations by 2pm. Please respond with ✅/❌ for your items.

Ravi: Swag pickup booked 12:30 from printer (QuickRuns). Tracking QR123456. ETA ~13:45. I’ll confirm once loaded. :truck:

Amanda: Got slides from Ana + Priya, uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/meetups/lilypad/slides. One slide has code overflow — can someone QA formatting?

CJ: I can QA 12:45–13:15. Bringing HDMI + USB-C->HDMI adapter. @Leo can you bring spare power strip?

Leo: Yep power strip + gaffer tape. Ordered 200 extra stickers yesterday. Order #ORD-7789. ETA matches Ravi pickup. Sending PO to finance now.

events-bot: Booth reservation confirmed — Table 7B (6ft), power access A1. Event contact: Maya (+1-555-9012). Calendar invite sent.

Sophie: Two asks: 1) Lead routing — QR -> Typeform -> Zapier -> Intercom inbox "events-lilypad". @Amanda can you confirm Zap mapping? 2) Messaging one-pager to hand out — Ravi can you draft a bench one-liner? I’ll pair on copy.

Amanda: Zap mapping confirmed. Fields: name, email, company, interest, notes, utm_campaign. Zap posts to Intercom inbox "events-lilypad" and tags 'meetup', also appends an Airtable row. I’ll run an end-to-end test at 13:20.

Ravi: Draft for one-pager: "Redwood Inference — production-grade inference that scales predictably. Lower per-token cost with batching, KV-caching, and quantization-aware execution." Thoughts?

Sophie: Love it. Shorten for postcard back: "Production-grade inference: predictable latency, lower per-token cost." Add 3 bullets: Hosted API, Dedicated pools, Private VPC. Keep font large.

CJ: Ops note for demos — set local model runner to a small quantized variant to avoid heat/spikes. I’ll bring clip-on fans. Demo credentials: `demo_key_2024` (stored in 1Password).

Amanda: QA done — fixed overflow and exported final PDF deck. Uploaded final deck to drive link above. Also sent poster PDF to print (11x17, 0.125in bleed).

Leo: Shipping label created for extra sticker batch: SL-4452. Dropping to QuickRuns at 12:15 from office. Swag bag contents: 200 stickers, 50 tees (sizes in spreadsheet), 100 postcards.

Sophie: Lead follow-up plan: 48hr SLA. @CJ + @Amanda handle first-pass outreach, @Ravi triages product Qs, I’ll handle enterprise/SLA asks. Acknowledged?

CJ: Ack. I’ll prepare DM + schedule-demo templates and share by 15:00.

Amanda: Zap test success @13:32 — Intercom shows tag 'meetup' and Airtable row created. Screenshot uploaded to the drive folder.

Leo: Minor issue: banner grommet lost in transit. Event contact Maya said they can staple but prefer grommets. Bringing zip ties + small staple remover as fallback.

Sophie: Final checklist recap: pickup 12:30, QA 12:45–13:15, Zap test done, banner fallback, slides uploaded, postcards printed. If anything blocks, escalate here ASAP. Thanks all :raised_hands:
